extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open GM MeetMind" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "Sokuji_Virtual_Mic" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

wherebyGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise reduction for better performance.

defaultGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
If you don't see the complete audio device list in Teams settings:
1) Temporarily disable the GM MeetMind extension and refresh the page
2) Allow Teams to access your microphone and camera when prompted
3) Re-enable GM MeetMind extension and refresh the page again
4) Allow GM MeetMind to access your microphone when prompted
Now you should see both real and "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" devices in your settings.

jitsiGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind in Jitsi Meet, open Settings > Devices and select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" as your microphone. Then open Advanced audio settings and turn off Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, and Automatic gain control for clear translated audio.
